review_evidence: README identifies a formalization of Moreira's version of Sard's theorem and states that the main theorem is formalized.

The source tree contains the main proof development together with ToMathlib modules recording material intended or already prepared for upstreaming; those files are reusable mathematical prior art rather than redundant build output.
Even paths named Unused or ToMathlib may contain definitions/lemmas and are not safely removable by role or name, so no FILTER-004 lossless exclusion was established.
summary: Retain the full SardMoreira formalization, including ToMathlib and auxiliary modules; all are potentially reusable mathematical prior art.
